methods.method_purpose: Initialize the Printers class instance, inheriting from SmartFlow base class

classes.summary: The Printers class extends SmartFlow and represents a page object model for printer-related UI interactions in an iOS mobile application. It uses Selenium WebDriver for mobile automation and includes pytest integration. The class follows the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern for test automation, encapsulating printer management functionality. Notable patterns include exception handling for TimeoutException and NoSuchElementException, use of sleep for timing controls, and logging for debugging. The flow_name class attribute identifies this as the 'printers' flow within the Smart application framework.
